brainNote: Each DID is programmable: it knows where the call came from, what language to route in, how urgent it is, and what to do if no one answers. Because Telvergence controls the dial tone (carrier API → our own private network), the routing lives on infrastructure we own — your lead data never leaks to a third-party platform.

We own the network path — routing runs on infrastructure we control, so your lead data never leaks.
Geo, language, and urgency decided in milliseconds — the hottest call always jumps the queue.
24/7 AI answer, live agents, and a compliant outbound dialer — inbound and outbound in one system.

winnetH: Brands that share one network, one app, and every lead in real time.
winnetP: Each brand runs its own Smart-DID grid on the same Telvergence backbone — so when a job touches more than one trade, the lead flows across the network instead of dying in a voicemail box. Shared leads, shared customers, real-time analytics and automation on every job.
